desc: Make TestExecuteAgentProgressWatchdogStillBlocksDuringHandback and TestExecuteAgentBlocksSubmitStillRunningWhenGraceEnds deterministic by holding the session's in-flight marker from before executeAgent (D41), test-only, with a late-start regression subtest for each
